title: Best Polo Shirt (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were taken from the cited sources and ranked by the number of sources that mentioned them. The Sunspel Riviera was identified as the best overall in source 2, while the John Smedley Adrian and Chervo Anyone Polo were noted in source 2 and sources 3/4 respectively.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price information is included.
